summary: The agent built a robust gradient boosting pipeline with thorough feature engineering (target encoding, text SVD, date extraction). However, the solution suffers from critical data leakage by fitting TF-IDF and SVD on the combined train and test sets, as well as look-ahead bias by using randomized cross-validation on a temporal dataset. Additionally, global frequency encoding introduces minor test data leakage, and the final ensemble relies on an untuned naive average.
